Validate password reset token

Validates a password reset token and creates a session token for completing the password reset. This endpoint is called when a user clicks the password reset link in their email.

query Parameters
token
required
string

The password reset token received via email

Responses

    • "email": "user@example.com",
    • "session_token": "string"
    },

  • "error": "string"
}

Confirm password reset

Confirms and completes the password reset using the session token obtained from the validate endpoint.

required

session_token
required
string

The session token obtained from /users/password/reset/validate endpoint

password
required
string [ 8 .. 50 ] characters

The new password

verify_password
required
string [ 8 .. 50 ] characters

Verify the new password (must match password)

Get user profile by ID

Retrieves a user's enhanced profile information by user ID. Returns the same profile format as /users/me, but allows viewing other users' profiles. Requires authentication to prevent brute-force enumeration.

Authorizations:
jwtAuth
path Parameters
userId
required
string
Example: user-123

The unique identifier of the user

Get all listings

Returns listings with optional filters. Supports keyword search, amenities (CSV up to 10), price range, dates, rating, gender, and pagination via limit/offset.

query Parameters
q
string

Keyword search (title/description)

latitude
number <double>

Latitude of the user's location

longitude
number <double>

Longitude of the user's location

category
string

Category code from CategoryMeta registry. If provided, must be a valid category code; empty values are rejected with 400.

country
string

ISO2 country code to filter listings (e.g., CA)

city
string

City name to filter listings (exact match)

start_date
string <date-time>

Start date for availability check (ISO 8601)

end_date
string <date-time>

End date for availability check (ISO 8601)

price_min
number <double>

Minimum price filter

price_max
number <double>

Maximum price filter

gender
string

Filter by host gender

page
integer >= 1
Default: 1

Page number (starts at 1)

limit
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 10

Number of items per page

offset
integer >= 0

Offset for pagination (alternative to page)

Save listing draft

Save a listing draft with minimal validation. Allows users to save incomplete listing data that can be completed later. The status will be automatically set to 'draft'.

Authorizations:
jwtAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required

The listing draft data. Only title is required, all other fields are optional for drafts.

title
required
string <= 64 characters

Title of the listing (required for drafts)

description
string

Description of the listing

price
number <double> >= 0

Price per hour/day

thumbnail
string <uri>

Main thumbnail image URL

max_guests
integer <int32> >= 1

Maximum number of guests

instant_book
boolean

Whether instant booking is enabled

photos
Array of strings <uri> <= 10 items [ items <uri > ]

Array of photo URLs (minimum 3 required for publishing)

object

Host information

amenities
Array of strings <= 20 characters

List of available amenities

house_rules
Array of strings <= 5 characters

House rules for guests

cancellation_policy
string
Enum: "No refunds" "50% - 50% refund" "100% - Full Refund"

Cancellation policy

object

Address information (partial acceptable for drafts)

baggage_drop
boolean
Default: false

Baggage drop allowed by host so guests can drop off their bags first while they explore the city.

category_code
string
Enum: "couch_surfing" "co_working" "storages" "meeting_room" "kitchen" "retail_space" "classroom" "lounge" "shower" "studio" "playroom" "charging_station" "relax" "nightlife" "ride_share" "cleaning" "bike_rentals"
